name: switch-toggle
title: Switch Toggle
description: A tab-based switch toggle with animated floating background indicator. Includes a composed SwitchToggle.Group for quick usage. Uses Radix Tabs with namespace exports.

docs.lead: A tab-based switch toggle with an animated floating background indicator. Built on Radix Tabs for full accessibility.
docs.usage:
import * as SwitchToggle from "@/components/ui/switch-toggle"

<SwitchToggle.Root defaultValue="option1">
  <SwitchToggle.List>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value="option1">Option 1</SwitchToggle.Trigger>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value="option2">Option 2</SwitchToggle.Trigger>
  </SwitchToggle.List>
  <SwitchToggle.Content value="option1">Content 1</SwitchToggle.Content>
  <SwitchToggle.Content value="option2">Content 2</SwitchToggle.Content>
</SwitchToggle.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Rounded switch toggle with icons and text labels for a theme switcher.
examples.code:
<SwitchToggle.Root defaultValue='system'>
  <SwitchToggle.List>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='light'>
      <RiSunLine className='w-5 h-5 shrink-0' />
      Light
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='dark'>
      <RiMoonLine className='w-5 h-5 shrink-0' />
      Dark
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='system'>
      <RiEqualizer3Fill className='w-5 h-5 shrink-0' />
      System
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
  </SwitchToggle.List>
</SwitchToggle.Root>

examples.title: Icon Only (Rounded)
examples.description: Compact rounded variant with icon-only triggers, ideal for tight layouts.
examples.code:
<SwitchToggle.Root defaultValue='system'>
  <SwitchToggle.List className='w-fit gap-2 rounded-full' floatingBgClassName='rounded-full'>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='light' className='aspect-square h-9'>
      <RiSunLine className='w-6 h-6' />
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='dark' className='aspect-square h-9'>
      <RiMoonLine className='w-6 h-6' />
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
    <SwitchToggle.Trigger value='system' className='aspect-square h-9'>
      <RiEqualizer3Fill className='w-6 h-6' />
    </SwitchToggle.Trigger>
  </SwitchToggle.List>
</SwitchToggle.Root>

api.name: SwitchToggle.List
api.description: The tab list container with animated floating background indicator.

props.name: floatingBgClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the floating background indicator element

props.name: value

api.name: SwitchToggle.Content
api.description: The content panel displayed when its corresponding trigger is active.

props.name: value
props.description: The value matching the trigger this content belongs to

api.name: SwitchToggle.Group
